title: Primo page type config.yaml
description: Schema for page-types/{name}/config.yaml. Page-level field definitions live in a sibling fields.yaml.

$schema.description: Optional editor IntelliSense pointer. Ignored by import.

_id.description: System-owned page type ID. Keep existing IDs stable; omit this when creating a new page type.

color.description: Hex color (e.g. #2B407D) used by the editor UI to badge this page type.

allowed_blocks.description: Block folder names offered by the editor's add-block picker. Omit or leave empty for a static page type whose layout is fully defined by layout.yaml.
